definitions.explanation: Soft or pureed food given to infants as they transition from breast milk or formula to solid food, typically starting around 5-6 months of age.

notes:
{離乳食|りにゅうしょく} literally means "weaning food" — {離乳|りにゅう} (weaning) + {食|しょく} (food). In Japan, {離乳食|りにゅうしょく} typically progresses through stages from smooth purees to chunkier textures.
